Title: Good Morning With a Clear Sunrise at the Desert Oasis

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the Magic English Voyage desert map. Warm cream dawn light, soft sand and clay earth tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral-pink accents, soft pencil outlines, visible paper grain, low saturation, gentle imperfect brush texture. Child-safe attractive faces: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions, gentle smiles. Not glossy 3D, not plastic CGI, not neon, not hard vector.

Source Situation: Two young children meet at a desert oasis exactly as the morning begins. The main visual event is a visible sun rising above the horizon behind low dunes, with pale blue-to-gold dawn sky, long early shadows on the sand, and sleepy plants catching first light. The children are staged in a front-facing medium two-shot; they are slightly angled toward each other but both faces stay open to camera. They look at the rising sun, then smile and greet each other with "Good morning." No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.

CEFR Target: Pre-A1 / very young A1. The target English expression is "Good morning". The learner may not know any English. Keep lines short and natural. The expression "Good morning" must sound like a real morning greeting, not a drill.
